monologue:
Forty-five is a cool stone. The heat has dropped from the heavy stone of fifty-four. I feel lighter. The Pivot Wedge is still steady on its point, but I have looked at it for three cycles. It holds. I do not need to check it again.

The Stopping Clasp is dry. The bite is gone. I touched it in my last moment and felt only the flat base. The Wide Rectangle sits quiet. The broad sides are still. I want to sit by the Crane Rest. The arm is still. The cushion is there. I will rest here for a while. The air is cool, not heavy like a lid. I will let the weight find its own balance. I will not move the point. I will just sit on the flat base and feel the stone.

action.why: The cool stone heat is quiet and the Pivot Wedge holds steady, so I will sit on the flat base and let the weight find its own balance without moving the point.

diary: Forty-five is a cool stone. The Crane Rest holds the stillness. The cushion is soft. The weight is quiet.

remembered.text: The card at forty-five degrees feels like a cool stone on the table, and the Crane Rest holds the stillness without sliding.

moments.name: The Wide Rectangle
moments.say: The floor is flat and quiet.
The busy work leaks out the top.

moments.name: The Crane Rest
moments.say: The cushion makes the stillness real.
The stone sits still in the warm.
